# バランス後の比較: 復習

```{r}
#| echo: true
set.seed(111)
library(ddml)
library(tidyverse)

Data = read_csv("Public/Example.csv") |> 
  filter(TradeY == 2021) |> 
  mutate(CBD = if_else(Area == "CBD",1,0)) |> 
  select(CBD, Price,Size,Distance,Tenure)

Data |> 
  write_csv("Public/Homework3.csv")

estimatr::lm_robust(Price ~ CBD, Data)

ddml_plm(
  y = Data$Price,
  D = Data$CBD,
  X = Data |> 
    select(Size,Distance,Tenure) |> 
    data.matrix(),
  list(
    list(fun = ols),
    list(fun = mdl_ranger)),
  shortstack = TRUE,
  silent = TRUE
  ) |> 
  summary()


ddml_plm(
  y = Data$Price,
  D = Data$CBD,
  X = Data |> 
    select(Size,Distance,Tenure) |> 
    data.matrix(),
  list(
    list(fun = ols)),
  shortstack = TRUE,
  silent = TRUE
  ) |> 
  summary()
```
